description: Outcome-based persistent memory for AI coding tools (Claude Code, OpenCode)
release_notes: v0.5.8: Crash-resilience release. Enables SQLite WAL + FULL durability on the ChromaDB catalog so hard terminations (Windows port conflicts, external process kills, power loss) no longer corrupt or empty the database. Rewrites SessionManager.mark_scored() to perform an atomic temp-file replace, guaranteeing the session JSONL transcript survives a crash mid-write. Ships 16 new automated tests covering both fixes and fixes pre-existing test debt that left the full suite red on Windows. No data migration required; WAL applies on the next server start. 733 tests pass (3 skipped on Python 3.10 only for a test-harness teardown path).
